emily_support: Hi team, customer Zephyr hit intermittent failures after we applied the pinned model change yesterday. Ingest pipeline errors: "VecLengthMismatch: expected=1536 got=2048". Happens only for batched embedding requests (batch_size > 1). Indexing fails for ~15% of batch calls. They started seeing it ~10:30 UTC after the pin.

liam_engineering: Can you paste a minimal repro/curl and any response headers (model/variant/request-id)? Also any sample request ids so we can trace logs.

emily_support: Repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer XXX' \n -d '{"model":"open-embed-v2","inputs":["a","b","c","d"]}'
```
Error body: "{\"error\":\"VecLengthMismatch\", \"expected\":1536, \"got\":2048}"
Response headers from one failed call: `x-redwood-model: open-embed-v2-pinned`, `x-redwood-variant: open-embed-v2-legacy-quant`, `x-request-id: rz-13579`

support-bot: Routing trace (auto): request rz-13579 -> pool reserved-gpu-7 -> resolved variant open-embed-v2-legacy-quant due to capacity fallback.

david_runtime: I did a quick repro locally against staging. Sent 4 inputs in one request; server batched and then concatenated results from two workers. First worker returned 1536-dim embeddings, second returned 2048-dim from a legacy quantized variant. Batch concat code assumed equal dims and produced VecLengthMismatch when post-aggregation validations ran. Logs show: `alias-resolve: alias=open-embed-v2 -> chosen_variant=open-embed-v2-legacy-quant for node=gw-12 due to slot_pressure`.

ops-jen: Not great. Root cause seems to be alias resolution allowing fallback to a different-architecture variant when pinned. Short-term mitigation: require exact variant match for all sub-requests in a batch, or fail the request fast. We should also consider rolling back the alias mapping change made yesterday that relaxed strict variant pinning.

liam_engineering: I can add a defensive check at the batching boundary: when assembling a multi-worker batch, assert `dim == first_result.dim` and if mismatch raise `400 VecLengthMismatch` with a clear message and log request/worker ids for postmortem. That avoids silent corruption. I'll open PR and request an emergency review.

emily_support: Customer asked for immediate workaround — they can set `batch_size=1` or explicitly call `model=open-embed-v2-pinned` (variant-level parameter if available). I've told them to do that and offered to escalate to on-call. They want ETA.

david_runtime: Plan: hotfix check tonight -> canary in us-west -> prod rollout tomorrow morning. If rollback of alias mapping is faster, we may do that first. Will post request-ids and a follow-up thread after deploy.

ops-jen: Also adding this to the incident tracker and notifying CS to compensate Zephyr for index downtime. :eyes:

emily_support: Thanks — I'll update Zephyr with the temporary workaround and ETA. Leaving this open for eng follow up and postmortem. :thumbsup:
